card.name: Section number 6 in Adverse Reactions cross-references
card.fires_on: The number 6 (or the 2 in 6.2) inside a bracketed cross-reference such as "[see Adverse Reactions ( 6.1 )]" in drug label highlights.

modes.label: Number 6 opening the reference
modes.description: The digit 6 right after "Adverse Reactions (" in a see-reference.

modes.label: Digit 2 after 6.
modes.description: The 2 in 6.2 when the reference lists Warnings first and then Adverse Reactions.
modes.example: Adverse Reactions ( 6.<<2>> )] • Concurrent use of monoamine

card.writes: It pushes down closing template brackets like "}}", and weakly promotes unrelated tokens, so the output effect is mostly suppression of bracket endings.
card.plain: It marks the section number of the Adverse Reactions pointer in a label's cross-reference.
